description: S458: the compile-time literal check tests the BASE type, as the runtime judge does. `<count>: integer(>0) = 1.5` satisfies `>0` but 1.5 is not an integer, so it does not inhabit `integer(>0)`: E-CONTRACT-001. Before S458 it compiled with no error and, being a literal (static zone), with no runtime check either.
rationale: §53.3.4: the constrained type is a subtype of the base type; §53.4.2 rule 1 + §53.11: a literal that demonstrably fails is E-CONTRACT-001.
